Mi calificación es solo por el personal que despacha combustible. Lugar de paso en la ruta, personal que despacha combustible muy atento, y amable.
Personal dentro del local poco amable,  tuvimos que buscar las mesas  y sillas  para sentarnos en el deck

My rating is solely for the gas station staff. It's a convenient stop along the route, and the gas station staff were very attentive and friendly. However, the staff inside the station were unfriendly; we had to find tables and chairs to sit on the deck.
